field.name: materialresolver
field.summary: Resolver used to locate signing and verification material for certificate-backed operations.

field.name: materialstore
field.summary: Optional mutable store capability exposed by the configured resolver when registration operations are supported.

constructor.name: ConstructorStore
constructor.summary: Create a certificate-backed signature processor with a built-in in-memory material store.
constructor.param: Material store used for mutable signing and verification material registration operations.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a certificate-backed signature processor using the supplied material resolver and material store.
constructor.param: Material resolver used for signing and verification lookup.
Material store used for mutable signing and verification material registration operations.

method.name: GetSigningInfo
method.summary: Get signing metadata from the resolved signing material for the current signing operation.
method.param: Signing context for the current operation.
method.returns: Signing metadata, or the default value when no signing material could be resolved.

method.name: TryAddVerificationMaterial
method.summary: Try to register verification material in the underlying material store when one is available.
method.returns: True when the verification material was stored; otherwise false.

method.name: TryClearCurrentSigningMaterial
method.summary: Try to clear the current signing material selection in the underlying material store when one is available.
method.returns: True when the current signing material selection was cleared; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetCurrentSigningMaterial
method.summary: Try to get the current signing material selection from the underlying material store when one is available.
method.returns: True when current signing material was resolved; otherwise false.

method.name: TryRemoveVerificationMaterial
method.summary: Try to remove verification material from the underlying material store when one is available.
method.param: Format discriminator for the signer key identifier to remove.
Signer key identifier bytes to remove.
method.returns: True when matching verification material was removed; otherwise false.

method.name: TryResolveSigningMaterial
method.summary: Try to resolve signing material for the current signing operation.
method.param: Signing context for the current operation.
method.returns: True when signing material was resolved; otherwise false.

method.name: TryResolveVerificationMaterial
method.summary: Try to resolve verification material for the current validation operation.
method.param: Validation context for the current operation.
method.returns: True when verification material was resolved; otherwise false.

method.name: TrySetCurrentSigningMaterial
method.summary: Try to set the current signing material selection in the underlying material store when one is available.
method.param: Signing material to use for future signing operations.
method.returns: True when the current signing material selection was updated; otherwise false.

method.name: TrySign
method.summary: Try to sign the canonical signed region for the current operation using the resolved certificate private key.
method.param: Signing context for the current operation.
method.returns: True when signing succeeded; otherwise false.

method.name: Verify
method.summary: Verify the canonical signed region for the current operation using thumbprint-resolved certificate material.
method.param: Validation context for the current operation.
method.returns: Verification facts for downstream policy evaluation.
